mephistosSoulstone.name: Mephisto’s Soulstone
mephistosSoulstone.description: A bound quest trophy granted by The Guardian. Retained; it cannot be read or equipped.

khalimsHeart.name: Khalim’s Heart
khalimsHeart.description: Recover it in the Flayer Jungle after clearing the area. Consumed when assembling Khalim’s Will.

khalimsBrain.name: Khalim’s Brain
khalimsBrain.description: Recover it in the Great Marsh after clearing the area. Consumed when assembling Khalim’s Will.

khalimsEye.name: Khalim’s Eye
khalimsEye.description: Recover it in the Kurast Bazaar after clearing the area. Consumed when assembling Khalim’s Will.

khalimsFlail.name: Khalim’s Flail
khalimsFlail.description: Defeat the High Council in Travincal, then recover the Flail explicitly. Consumed when assembling Khalim’s Will.

khalimsWill.name: Khalim’s Will
khalimsWill.description: Assemble from all four components using the retained Horadric Cube. Consumed when breaking the Compelling Orb in Travincal. Claim the quest reward separately.

recipe.inputs: Assembly consumes every ingredient: {{ingredients}}. {{tool}} is retained.
recipe.ready: Ready to assemble {{item}} wherever you are.
recipe.unavailable: Recover every ingredient and {{tool}}, and complete the earlier quest objectives first. Assembly is portable.
recipe.owned: {{item}} assembled. Claim the quest reward separately in Quests.
recipe.consumed: {{item}} has been used at its destination. Its ingredients remain recorded as used.

jadeFigurine.name: Jade Figurine
jadeFigurine.description: Recover the figurine in the Spider Forest, then give it to Deckard Cain in Kurast Docks in exchange for the Golden Bird.

goldenBird.name: Golden Bird
goldenBird.description: Cain exchanged this bird for the Jade Figurine. Give it to Alkor in Kurast Docks.

potionOfLife.name: Potion of Life
potionOfLife.description: Read once for +{{maxLife}} permanent maximum Life. Current Life and XP do not change.

recovery.ready: Recover this previously claimed quest reward. This does not grant XP.

gidbinn.name: The Gidbinn
gidbinn.description: Recover this sacred blade in the Flayer Jungle, then give it to Ormus in Kurast Docks.

lam_esens_tome.name: Lam Esen’s Tome
lam_esens_tome.description: Recover this ancient tome in the Kurast Bazaar, then give it to Alkor in Kurast Docks.

questItems.bound: Bound to this character. Does not use backpack or stash space.

horadricCube.name: Horadric Cube
horadricCube.description: Retained tool for Horadric transmutation. Bound to this character.

bookOfSkill.name: Book of Skill
bookOfSkill.description: Read once to gain {{skillPoints}} skill point.
